newsitem.title: PERU: Agriculture sector leads Peru's January growth.
newsitem.headline: Agriculture sector leads Peru's January growth.

text.p: The agriculture sector registered 17.1 percent year-on-year growth in January, to lead Peru's 4.5 percent overall growth in that month, the National Institute of Statistics and Information (INEI) said Wednesday.
The INEI added that the worst-performing sector in January was fishing, which dropped 17.3 percent.
Among other sectors, construction was up 11.2 percent, commercial activity 5.3 percent, manufacturing 2.4 percent, electricity and water 2.4 percent and mining 0.1 percent.
The INEI's category for "others," including the transport, financial and government sectors, rose 3.5 percent.
The government is predicting four to five percent growth this year, compared with 2.8 percent in 1996.
